definitions.explanation: The act of actively working to attract or bring in something desirable, such as hosting an event, luring investment, or bringing businesses to a region.

examples.japanese: ⟦オリンピック→オリンピック：09899_orinpikku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{誘致|ゆうち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}した→成功する：21445_seikousuru⟧。
examples.english: The bid to host the Olympics was successful.

examples.japanese: ⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧{誘致|ゆうち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雇用|こよう}→雇用：04840_koyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{増|ふ}やしたい→増やす：02410_fuyasu⟧。
examples.english: We want to increase local employment by attracting businesses.

examples.japanese: ⟦{市|し}→市：01599_shi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{観光客|かんこうきゃく}→観光客：03022_kankoukyaku⟧{誘致|ゆうち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{企画|きかく}→企画：04879_kikaku⟧し、⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{訪問者|ほうもんしゃ}→訪問者：20148_houmonsha⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: The city planned new events to attract tourists, and visitors from abroad have been increasing.

notes:
A compound of {誘|ゆう} (to invite, to lure) and {致|ち} (to bring about). Functions as a suru verb ({誘致|ゆうち}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧). A formal term commonly used in news and policy discussions about economic development, event hosting, and tourism promotion.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧{誘致|ゆうち}: attracting businesses
- ⟦{観光客|かんこうきゃく}→観光客：03022_kankoukyaku⟧{誘致|ゆうち}: attracting tourists
- ⟦オリンピック→オリンピック：09899_orinpikku⟧{誘致|ゆうち}: Olympic bid
- ⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧{誘致|ゆうち}: attracting factories
- {誘致|ゆうち}⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧: attraction/bidding activities

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {招致|しょうち}: invitation, inviting — very similar; {招致|しょうち} emphasizes formally inviting, while {誘致|ゆうち} emphasizes actively luring
- ⟦{呼|よ}び{込|こ}み→呼び込む：06087_yobikomu⟧: attracting, drawing in — more colloquial, used for customers and crowds
- ⟦{勧誘|かんゆう}→勧誘：16850_kanyuu⟧: solicitation, recruitment — approaching individuals to join or buy
